description: 北九州市 避難場所・避難所(共通フォーマット) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 北九州市の避難場所・避難所を、北九州市、福岡市、久留米市の３市で共通化したフォーマットにしたデータです。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 共通フォーマット, 施設, 緯度経度, 避難場所, 避難所. It offers 48 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
